title: wsReconnect.test.ts claims to test the DEX WebSocket reconnect but its backoff, fallback and disconnect cases re-implement the logic inside the test or only call the mock provider, so the registered reconnect S1 (leaked providers, racing loops, no backfill, no error listener) passes green

evidence.note: backoff cases compute Math.min(reconnectDelay * 2, maxDelay) in the test; the comment says this "validates the reconnect delay logic from handleWsClose in bot.ts"
the real V3 reconnect loop (AUD-BUY-008), never imported by the test
HTTP fallback case asserts !null === true on local objects
disconnect cases call createMockProvider methods that reject and catch the error in the test body
the provider-cache cases use a MockWebSocketProvider with no websocket, so the missing error listener (src/utils/provider.ts:37, AUD-ANTIRUG-002 sibling) cannot surface

sibling_sites_checked: All 11 cases of the file. The provider-cache cases (17-117) run the real src/utils/provider getWsProvider/removeWsProvider and are sound for what they claim. The anti-rug reconnect sibling is AUD-TESTI-004.
severity_rationale: S2: tautological tests on a money-relevant path (missed or duplicated snipes, overspend per AUD-BUY-008) that claim reconnect coverage while running none of it.
recommendation: Phase 28: drive startDexListener with a loopback ws server that closes the socket, assert one reconnect loop, the old provider destroyed, the gap backfilled and the process alive on a refused reconnect (RED today). Delete the in-test arithmetic cases.
affected_cases: delay doubles on failure: 1s -> 2s -> 4s -> ... up to 60s max
delay never exceeds 60s even after many failures
wsProvider null condition triggers HTTP polling path
provider methods throw after disconnect, caller catches gracefully
ECONNRESET error is caught and logged without crashing
escaped_regression: Change bot.ts:1559 to grow the delay without the 60 s cap, or drop the removeWsProvider call before reconnecting: every backoff and disconnect case stays green because none of them runs bot.ts.
